title: Sheep holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='12' fill='#f4f1e8'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='62' r='11' fill='#e8e4d8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='62' r='11' fill='#e8e4d8'/>

  <circle cx='46.5' cy='38.5' r='0.9' fill='#6b5b4d'/>
  <!-- heart held in front -->
  <path d='M45 68 C45 63 38 60 38 65 C38 69 45 75 45 75 C45 75 52 69 52 65 C52 60 45 63 45 68 Z' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <path d='M43 66 C42.5 64.5 40 64 40 65.5 C40 67 43 69.5 43 69.5 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>

  <rect x='39' y='68' width='5' height='9' rx='2.5' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
  <rect x='47' y='68' width='5' height='9' rx='2.5' fill='#8a7a6a'/>
